description: Test script for validating HAL API CcspHalEthSwGetPortAdminStatus() for Ethernet switch port admin status, using tdklib and specific test parameters.

classes.name: tdklib.TDKScriptingLibrary
classes.description: Library class for scripting test cases, providing methods to load modules, create test steps, and manage test execution.

methods.name: configureTestCase
methods.description: Configures the test case with IP, port, and test name.

methods.name: createTestStep
methods.description: Creates a test step object for executing specific test functions.

methods.name: addParameter
methods.description: Adds parameters to the test step.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Executes the test case with expected result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of the test execution.

methods.name: setResultStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the test result.

methods.name: unloadModule
methods.description: Unloads the specified module after test completion.
